method: Browser streamed the full file, hashed every byte (incremental SHA-256, self-tested against WebCrypto) and kept records whose triangle centre lies within 12.5 km (1737.4 km sphere) of each IAU feature centre. Line format: site_id TAB distance_km TAB raw 208-character record.
